turns.replyText:
How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Hi! For the best experience with the Mesa Loop 30oz, here’s how to use it well 😊

Use it for cold drinks and everyday hydration.
Make sure the straw is twisted in securely so it locks into the lid.
Unlock the covered lid before sipping, then click it closed again when you’re done to help keep the mouthpiece clean.
Keep the bottle upright in bags when possible for the best leak-resistant performance.
Wash before first use.

For cleaning:

Bottle and lid are top-rack dishwasher safe.
Disassemble the lid before cleaning.
Remove the silicone plug and straw before dishwashing.
Place the straw upright in the dishwasher so water can flow through it.
Let everything air dry fully before storing.
Do not microwave.

A couple of small tips that help a lot:

Don’t overfill it.
After reassembling, double-check that the straw and silicone pieces are seated properly.

That usually gives the best day-to-day performance ✨ Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
